items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I went down, and was accepted by Tommy Dorsey.

ctx.x: Well, we just got through joining Tommy Dorsey in 1939.

No, no. Tommy knew me from a Battle of Music with Artie Shaw when we cut them -- Billie Holiday was singing with us, and we cut his great band which was the number one band at Dartmouth College Winter Carnival. He knew my reputation as a drummer because we cut them a brand new one -- that's how that goes, so that's why he wanted me to come with his orchestra. That's what little reputation I had spread around with Artie Shaw, and so I went down, and was accepted by Tommy Dorsey. I arrived June 19th, 1939. I went…
